lines.text: You have not seen the kettle.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A plaque on the pump housing bears Ada’s name beneath Lysandre’s seal.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You made this?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The first pump. It kept the clinic dry. They put flowers on it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And the barricades?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ada wipes rain from the plaque with her thumb. The name remains.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: You will want a clean answer. I have been trying to give myself one for months.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I want to know whether we can trust your plans.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The plans, yes. Me, you will have to watch for a while.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She rolls the street map open on a crate. Under the rain stains, she has marked every pump still serving a home.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: People need these pump parts.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Enforcer
lines.text: Civilian maintenance is suspended. Authorized infrastructure will be restored.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After victory you carry supplies through the gate. Behind you, the checkpoint begins restoring itself.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Keep moving. Winning bought us time.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The first pump kept a clinic dry. I still remember the applause. Someone put flowers on the intake housing.
lines.direction: remorse without asking to be forgiven

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That sounds worth building.
lines.direction: remorse without asking to be forgiven

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: It was. I used that fact every time the next order looked wrong.
lines.direction: remorse without asking to be forgiven

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What made you stop?
lines.direction: remorse without asking to be forgiven

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: A repair request from that same clinic. I had signed the order taking its pump apart.
lines.direction: remorse without asking to be forgiven

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The clinic matron used to wave when she saw me. Now she checks what I have brought first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What did you bring today?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The right pipe. I checked the number four times.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then let us get it there before the wall comes back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: These instruments will repair time.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Our foundations are washing away while you say that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The maintenance ledger shows Galactic holding fractures open while Lysandre’s network extracts material through them.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you know it was taking material through fractures?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I knew where the intake was. I stopped asking what the intake meant.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You sound as though you have answered that question before.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Mostly to the ceiling. Thank you for making me answer someone else.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: These components do not belong to one yesterday.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: He said the system recovered what we lost.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You secure a distribution key that can isolate civilian pumps. Nobody has established what extraction does to the source.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You keep saying we. Who is left from your crew?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Most of them. We stopped speaking for a while. That made the work worse and the lunches unbearable.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What did you say when you went back?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I said I was sorry. Then I asked who needed a spanner.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did that fix it?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The pipe? Yes. The rest is taking longer.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Do not ask the crew whether they have forgiven me. Someone did that last week. It made lunch awful again.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I was going to ask where to put this.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Oh. Left shelf. Thank you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can become very good at left shelves before trying anything more complicated.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: You have seen the streets. You know why the machinery cannot stop.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I have the distribution key. The civilian pumps can run independently.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Lysandre looks at the key, then at Ada. For the first time since you entered, his hand leaves the recovery console.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: You would turn a system built for everyone into a collection of vulnerable little repairs?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The clinic asked for a little repair. I signed the order taking its pump away.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: And I signed the order restoring an entire district. You were proud of that work.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I am. I have used it to excuse too much already.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What is at the source?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: Remnants of a region which cannot support continuity. They can still serve a purpose here.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You did not even say there was nobody left.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The recovery console lights beneath Lysandre’s hand.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: I will not watch this city die while we debate an abandoned yesterday.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Then help me keep the pumps running without it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He does not take the key.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You win. Lysandre orders a network recovery, but Ada uses the access you recovered to interrupt it. Broken barricades stay broken.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something enormous moves beneath the hall.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I thought he might look at me. Just once.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He heard what you said.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: That is worse, somehow. Give me a moment before we start the next pump.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I will watch the controls. You can look somewhere else.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Seismitoad ruling the realm blocks the extraction engine. Its calls coordinate the patrols.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Keep it away from the controls. I can disconnect the network.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What happens when it stops?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Tomorrow, we fix things ourselves.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The engine falls silent. Patrol calls stop. Lysandre escapes, but loses this supply network.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Now people can choose what they rebuild.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Listen to the pipes.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They sound broken.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: One is. There is nobody pretending it will repair itself before we notice.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Tell us what to carry. We can be useful before we leave.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: People need these pump parts.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Courier
lines.text: Everything arrives accounted for.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Accounted for where?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Courier
lines.text: Here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The manifest lists machinery for stations across eras. No departure station is recorded.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Courier
lines.text: There is no departure station. I never thought to ask for one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You can ask now.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Courier
lines.text: I know. I am trying to decide whether I am afraid of the answer or of everyone seeing me ask.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can wait here while you decide.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Superintendent
lines.text: No recognized settlements remain at the source.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That does not mean nothing was there.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: An overridden audit warns: Source continuity degraded. Further recovery not advised. You recover the extraction coordinates.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You have been working since we arrived.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I am waiting for this gauge to settle.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You said that at the last gauge.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ada looks at the two of you, then lowers herself onto a supply crate.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Five minutes. If anyone calls it an intervention, I am getting up.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We were going to call it lunch.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: You may both stop watching the gauge. I am sitting down.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am watching to learn what it does.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: That is an outrageous excuse. I use it constantly.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then you can tell us about it while you eat. We have opinions about that arrangement too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: The sealed audit names an Expedition–Skyridge realm: Continuity purge completed. Surviving material approved for reclamation.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Abandoned remnants. That was the phrase in the proposal.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you ask how they knew?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Water drips from Ada’s sleeve onto the audit.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: No.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: There might still be someone there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I know. Please do not make that easier for me to hear.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In the street, a resident levers a brick out of the barricade. It stays out. Someone laughs in disbelief.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Come and look with us.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I am needed at the clinic. By people who have excellent reasons to refuse to let me through the door.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What will you say?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I have spare parts. After that, I shall have to listen.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pushes the insulated gloves into your hands.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: When you get there, send names. I can read the measurements later.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will send what we find. I cannot promise what that will be.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Good. Neither of us should start with another promise we cannot keep.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The road ends halfway across a bridge. A leaf drifts beyond the broken edge and vanishes. Nothing below receives it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot feel where it went.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Come back from the edge.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I could try to—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Please do not finish that sentence.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A woman stands behind you holding a lantern in daylight. On Galactic’s map, her house is an empty parcel.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: They have already repaired this place three times. I would like somebody to ask what is here before the fourth.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We came to find out what happened.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Most visitors say that. Then they look at the edge instead of at me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You turn away from the bridge. Edda waits until Celebi does too.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They took pieces from here to rebuild somewhere else.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: After the purge. The severing came first. Some of us were still packing.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At her house, a register lies beside a bowl of soup. Edda moves the register when your wet sleeve brushes it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am sorry.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The paper is old. I get angry about the wrong things when I am tired.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Are these the people who died?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: These are the people I have not found. There is a difference. I need you to keep it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: Can your Pokémon hold their ground when the way back disappears? We prepare here before taking the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After the trial Oren marks a safe route. Celebi offers to restore the missing bridge.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Do you know what is on the other side? Then we find out first.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: I used to count every step across that bridge. Made the dark feel shorter.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: How many?
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: It changed. I hated that.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do you count now?
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: People across. Then I take my lantern back for the next one.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Does that make the dark shorter?
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: No. But there is something worth doing in it.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I nearly promised Edda I could bring the bridge back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You caught yourself.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Because she was watching me. I want to learn to catch myself before somebody has to look that way.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You can begin by coming to supper when I call you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Galactic told us to leave until the routes were settled. We brought back everyone we could reach.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You prepare together before exploring the old canals.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Markers show Pokémon guiding evacuees toward a smaller passage after human patrols lost access.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Maren gave me this coin for the ferry. Would not hear that the crossing was free.
lines.direction: earthy humor; affection for absent people

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You kept it.
lines.direction: earthy humor; affection for absent people

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: She told me to buy myself something ridiculous once everyone was safe.
lines.direction: earthy humor; affection for absent people

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What will you buy?
lines.direction: earthy humor; affection for absent people

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: A hat. The sort that catches on absolutely everything. I have had time to choose.
lines.direction: earthy humor; affection for absent people

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: I have almost spent that coin three times. Silly, is it not?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It sounds like you are waiting to tell her what you bought.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Yes. Thank you for making that sound less foolish than it feels.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When we send word, I am going to ask about the hat first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Galactic equipment alarms the guardian. You set the audit down.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We followed what they took. We are looking for those who left.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The evacuation recording names an unknown destination. Celebi feels movement through its fading trace.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They made it through. Far away.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I felt them moving away. I wanted to follow before it went quiet.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You would have gone without telling us.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I was going to tell you afterward.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Yes. That is what people say when they expect somebody to wait for them.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Your report says this region was cleared. We are still here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: The machinery cannot simply stay active.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: And you cannot disconnect routes that still carry people.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After defeat Venn checks the live map. Occupied areas were excluded from its readings. He gives you the access seal.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: I can hold the return passage open.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Start there.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: I can add the occupied routes to the report.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You can carry a copy to the people who crossed them out.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: I was one of those people.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Edda closes the register with her hand still between the pages.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Then you already know where to begin. Oren needs the eastern marker lit tonight.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: I can do that.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Tell him. He is the one going out in the dark.
lines.direction: uncomfortable accountability; no easy absolution

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was giving us the seal enough?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: For the door, yes. I do not know what enough for the rest would look like.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He waited for you to say something kind.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: He can help Oren while he waits. I have work to do too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It thinks we are taking this place too.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Then show it what we are protecting.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian yields. Edda preserves the refuge routes while Celebi repairs one stable connection. The vanished landscape does not suddenly return.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: We can search from here tomorrow.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It is only one connection.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I can get to Oren’s house through it. He has a chair I have been refusing to return for years.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That sounds like a dangerous precedent for borrowed furniture.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I intend to visit the chair. Let us not become reckless.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: Can your Pokémon hold their ground when the way back disappears? We prepare here before taking the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: That does not mean everyone got out.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Local surveyors requested more time. Command ordered disconnection despite incomplete evacuation.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They had asked for more time. They knew.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Yes. I have been trying to tell people that for a long while.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am sorry we needed the paper.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Take it with you. Perhaps the next person will listen sooner.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You read my reports.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Engineer
lines.text: I could not make the routes agree.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: So you stopped counting the people on them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Galactic severed contradictory branches to simplify the origin-site calculation. The purge failed and destabilized adjacent routes.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: My old kitchen is still on their map. My neighbor’s house is marked as an empty parcel.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was it damaged?
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: She painted the door blue the week before the order. She wanted the children to find it easily.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What was her name?
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Maren. I will show you how she writes it. She has a very untidy M.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I remember the paint on Maren’s thumb. Of all the things to keep remembering.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Was she pleased with the door?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Absurdly. She brought me outside twice to look at it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Will you show us where it was? We can look with you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The traces tell a clearer story: Galactic ordered the purge, and Lysandre took material from the remains. One evacuation group escaped forward. The route points to 2006.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can follow them.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Can you bring them back?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi looks at you. You wait.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I am sorry. I promised myself I would not ask the first person who found a way out to fix everything.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You can ask. We just have to tell you the truth.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Edda takes a letter from the register. Its envelope is soft from being handled.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Maren. The blue door. You will know her M if you see it. She never could leave enough room for the other letters.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What should we say first?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: That I was angry. No. She will know that.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She starts to open the envelope, then smooths it closed.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Tell her the door is still blue. Start there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And after that?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: If she wants to know, tell her I set out two bowls for longer than was sensible.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She gives you the letter before she can take it back.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Lightning hits the lake. A Gyarados rises under your stranded boat and pushes it toward a pier. Its scales throw sparks across the rain.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is a Gyarados.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Very observant. Get out before it decides to tip you out.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Its whole signature is different.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: It still hates being kept waiting.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: An evacuation ribbon hangs from a post. You show Ivo the register. He runs for someone before you finish explaining.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Edda?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She reads the name twice. When you offer the letter, she dries her hands on her apron so carefully that you stop holding it out and lay it on the table.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: She said the door is still blue.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: That obstinate woman. I told her the paint would peel.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Maren laughs. Then she sits down very abruptly.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Is that a good thing to say?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: It is exactly what she would say. Give me a moment, dear.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dr. Sen leads you outside. The bell on the pier rings; the strange Gyarados turns toward it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dr. Sen
lines.text: Years have passed for the evacuees. The crossing altered the Pokémon. We built Newbank around the lives that arrived.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Galactic wants to put them back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dr. Sen
lines.text: Galactic has a measurement from before the crossing. It is rather pleased with itself for calling it normal.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Come down to the water when you have eaten. I will introduce you to what normal is doing today.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: You keep looking at Raichu like it is doing something wrong.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am learning.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Good. It is patient with that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Maren rings an old evacuation bell. The lightning Gyarados approaches: it is the same individual that guided the boats.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Different thunder. Same habit of splashing everyone.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: You can stop apologizing to Raichu. It has already forgiven you. It mostly wants the snack in your bag.
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I was hoping nobody had noticed.
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: The whole pier noticed. We have made the same face at visitors ourselves.
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Do you remember the old place?
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Bits. A stair I could not climb. Maren carrying a pot with a tree in it.
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did the tree survive?
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: You are sitting under it.
lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I knew Maren before I knew I knew her. I keep looking for her in the missing part.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: She is in the kitchen. You can look there first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We may have been making this harder than it needed to be.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am still going to ask whether I liked her cooking.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: We will prepare together before entering the unstable inlet.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi starts restoring earlier water conditions. The resident Pokémon become distressed.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Stop. That water has not been right for them in years. Look at what is here now.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: I sounded angry back there. I was frightened.
lines.direction: firmness followed by honesty

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought you knew what I was trying to do.
lines.direction: firmness followed by honesty

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: I did. I also saw the reeds start dying. Those are where the young Pokémon hide.
lines.direction: firmness followed by honesty

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You could have said that before we entered.
lines.direction: firmness followed by honesty

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: I should have. I spend so much time defending this place that I forget newcomers cannot see what I am defending.
lines.direction: firmness followed by honesty

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: The first week here, I kept bringing the wrong supplies down to the water. I was angry with it for changing.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Were you angry with the Pokémon too?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: I was very careful to say I was not. They noticed anyway.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: They seem pleased to see you now. That must have taken more than the right supplies.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Examiner

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Preserving strength is sensible. Sometimes someone needs you to spend it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Galactic’s retreat order prioritized instruments over its missing team. The sanctuary has been helping those abandoned travelers.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: How many keys do you have?
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Enough that I sound like a kitchen when I walk.
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do they open?
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Rooms. A store cupboard. One door that is not here anymore. I keep meaning to put that key down.
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Why have you not?
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Sometimes a thing takes longer than deciding it should. You may find that irritating.
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I think I find it familiar.
lines.direction: soft spoken; practical rather than mystical

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: You do not have to keep checking whether the bag is too heavy for me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I was checking whether you had eaten. Tarin said—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Tarin has an unsound relationship with other people’s provisions. I have eaten.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am putting that exact phrase in the expedition journal.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It could leave.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: It knows. It stays because this is where others arrive.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian reveals energy straining to keep a damaged connection open. It cannot tell whether releasing it would help.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought a sanctuary would be quieter.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Usually. You arrived during an argument about whose turn it was to sweep.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do the dragons argue about that?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Would you like to ask Garchomp? I have been looking for a volunteer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: Celebi can finish the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We are listening to those who know what is beyond it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After defeat the captain accepts evacuation and releases the recorder. It shows volcanic light and a vast silhouette: GROUDON EVENT — ANCHOR FRAGMENT DETECTED.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: You would spend your supplies bringing my team down?
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: You are on the mountain. We have ropes.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: After what we tried to do?
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: You will answer questions below. Hold the rope properly or neither of us will enjoy the journey.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You can be angry and still help.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I have considerable practice.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The captain left names off the equipment manifest.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: People take longer to account for. They also argue with the results.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I want to hear the argument from the people he left here.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will send the list to Sera. She knows who is still waiting.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot promise to fix everything. I will not pretend I understand something because I fear it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Coming back is part of the task.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian grants controlled passage. Celebi remembers Dialga before his transformation, waiting patiently beside a damaged structure.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I trusted him.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: My legs will not stop shaking. I do not even use them to cross.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Mine either. We make a very dignified expedition.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Wait until we reach Sera’s mat. She has a way of restoring humility.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I think I would like her to tell us off about the boots again.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardians open a route backward to 2004. Heat pulses through it. Sera ties a signal charm to your wrist: a way to call the retreat point.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You have checked the knot three times.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I will be here when you need the fourth.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: That night, you take the last watch beside the stove. Celebi keeps opening its journal without turning a page.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You have stopped telling me when you are tired.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You have enough to worry about.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That sounds like something I would say.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You sit with that longer than either of you intended.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I miss choosing a walk because it looked nice. I miss getting to the end of a day without wondering which day it was.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought you liked coming with me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I do. I can like you and want to go home.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know whether I have a home to miss. It makes me angry when you talk about yours. I am sorry.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I would rather know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Across the room, Lio turns over and pulls a blanket across Tarin’s feet. Neither wakes.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When this is over, could I come on one of those walks?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes. You may have to listen to me complain about something extremely ordinary.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I would like a turn at that too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A dead tree rises from black stone. Under the crust, the rivers glow. Groudon shifts in the basin and the ground answers.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Stay on the marked road. If I say move, argue afterward.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Whose marks?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Mine. I know what that asks you to trust.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She unfolds a survey. An old Magma seal has been scratched out so hard that the paper is thin beneath it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You worked with Maxie.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I surveyed the expansion zones. He amplified an exposed anchor fragment. Groudon is caught feeding the same upheaval back into it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Galactic?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: They measured it and left. This was ours.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She points to a straight red line through a scatter of little squares.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: A woman asked me to move this six feet. Her garden was in the way.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Did you?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I explained the tolerances. Very patiently. I have heard my own voice doing it every night since.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is she alive?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I do not know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rhea folds the map before you can say anything kind.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: There is a water delivery at the checkpoint. Help me get that through first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: People built this station before your expansion.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: Civilian collection resumes when construction is complete.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You restore water deliveries. A resident points toward a flash preceding each tremor.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then we follow the light.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The captain used to share my lunch. He looked past me as though he had forgotten.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He had not forgotten.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I know. I would prefer you had let me pretend for a minute.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can be quiet while you get the water loaded.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: We prepare here before taking the repair crew in.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cooling station was deliberately redirected toward an amplifier. Magma is actively sustaining the spread.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: Those goggles are not a decoration. Put them over your eyes.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought they were yours.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I am wearing mine. I look like this underneath them as well.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You sound very calm.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I am following the checklist. The calm is a favorable side effect.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you always carry a spare pair?
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: Someone always thinks they are a decoration.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I marked the houses before the ash came. She told me I was being dramatic.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I did.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do you need from her now?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: A cart. We can finish being angry when these people have water.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: You cannot break what you do not understand.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then give us the instructions.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Restricted.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You secure the intact cooling controls and a safe sequence for reducing output without collapse.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I knew about the pressure loss. I wrote it in the margin, where someone could choose not to read it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Why?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I wanted credit for noticing without having to be the person who stopped the work.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then put your name beside the warning we send back. Big enough to find.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Maxie stands over the basin map. He has drawn the new coastline in a steady, careful hand.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: Rhea. You understand what these readings could mean.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I understand the cavities under the western road. I put them in your report.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: A report of risk. Every worthwhile undertaking has one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: There were homes on that road.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: There will be homes on land nobody could have imagined a generation ago.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Who gets to grow old enough to live in them?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rhea lays the evacuation map across his coastline. Her pencil catches on a scorched fold.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Tell me where the water goes, Maxie. Today. These people cannot drink the future.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: You came here to build something greater than yourself.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I came because you made me feel clever. It took me far too long to notice who was paying for that.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Below the platform, Groudon moves. The fragment’s signal surges against every instrument in the room.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After victory the crew begins a controlled shutdown. Maxie reaches for emergency controls, then sees Groudon struggling against another pulse. He leaves them untouched.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I used to wait for him to finish speaking before I let myself decide whether I agreed.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You did not wait today.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I was afraid if I gave him another minute, I would start making excuses for him.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He saw you leave. Whatever he tells himself about it later, he saw.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: We can stop the machinery.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will hold here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When the pulses stop, I can reach the fragment.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The last amplifier falls silent. Groudon settles onto the stone. Lava remains, but the next expected tremor never comes.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Together the crew transfers the remaining load. Only then does Celebi recover the fragment and close its small fracture.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: You can stop counting the intervals now. The gauge has settled.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Give it another minute.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dalen sets a cup of clean water beside her without taking the gauge away.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You do not have to pretend you are relieved yet.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Good. I do not think I remember how.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can wait.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That gesture is in both memories. I want to reach out and make it finish.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Do not.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: She was speaking to both of us, I think.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I was. I am getting better at recognizing a very bad idea when someone else is having it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: People built this station before your expansion.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: Civilian collection resumes when construction is complete.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The captain used to share my lunch. He looked past me as though he had forgotten.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He had not forgotten.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I know. I would prefer you had let me pretend for a minute.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can be quiet while you get the water loaded.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: The new map accounts for potential.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The old one accounted for people.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Original surveys show cavities beneath supposedly stable expansion zones.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Six feet. That was all she asked me to move the line.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can mark where the garden was.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Leave the square empty until we know. I have drawn enough things over that woman without asking.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can write her name beside it. You remembered that.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: You believed in this.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I believed you would stop if it hurt people.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Maxie overrode warnings. You recover a procedure to isolate the fragment without tearing the installation apart.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I kept the badge for a week after I left. Put it in a drawer each morning. Took it out again.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you think Maxie would change his mind?
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I wanted him to say I had been right. An embarrassing thing to want while people needed a road.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Do you still want it?
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Some days. I can want it and get the water delivered anyway.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You still wanted him to say you had been right.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: You were not supposed to notice that part.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I notice when Rowan does not look pleased with me. It makes me want to do something impressive and unwise.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Then let us agree to be deeply unimpressive until the fragment is secured.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.
