lines.text: Tell me where the water goes, Maxie. Today. These people cannot drink the future.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: You came here to build something greater than yourself.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I came because you made me feel clever. It took me far too long to notice who was paying for that.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Below the platform, Groudon moves. The fragment’s signal surges against every instrument in the room.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After victory the crew begins a controlled shutdown. Maxie reaches for emergency controls, then sees Groudon struggling against another pulse. He leaves them untouched.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I used to wait for him to finish speaking before I let myself decide whether I agreed.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You did not wait today.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I was afraid if I gave him another minute, I would start making excuses for him.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He saw you leave. Whatever he tells himself about it later, he saw.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: We can stop the machinery.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will hold here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When the pulses stop, I can reach the fragment.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The last amplifier falls silent. Groudon settles onto the stone. Lava remains, but the next expected tremor never comes.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Together the crew transfers the remaining load. Only then does Celebi recover the fragment and close its small fracture.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: You can stop counting the intervals now. The gauge has settled.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Give it another minute.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dalen sets a cup of clean water beside her without taking the gauge away.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You do not have to pretend you are relieved yet.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Good. I do not think I remember how.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can wait.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That gesture is in both memories. I want to reach out and make it finish.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Do not.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: She was speaking to both of us, I think.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I was. I am getting better at recognizing a very bad idea when someone else is having it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The recovered fragment repeats a gesture in two different positions. Celebi reaches toward it, then pulls back before the records can overlap again.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot tell which one happened first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Then wrap it up. You nearly fell last time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Galactic left a file on watchers in 2011. They might know how to read it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Below, Maxie’s released supplies reach the evacuation crews. A cart wheel sticks in the new road. Three people shove it free.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: They will say he helped. Some of them will mean it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He did help with the supplies.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I know. I wanted that to be simpler too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi hovers over the old survey until Rhea lays it flat.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: If you find the woman, what will you say about her garden?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I keep practicing an explanation. None of it sounds like something she asked me for.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Perhaps start by asking where she wants the road.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Perhaps she wants me nowhere near it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She gives you the route readings, then checks the signal charm Sera tied to your wrist.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That is a good knot. Tell her I said so.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You can tell her yourself. We have room on the channel.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Blue flames hang between the trees. Something metallic moves beneath the roots. In your pack, the fragment stops trembling.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Put it on the cloth. Your hand has been closed around it since you came through.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: If I let go, will it stop showing us?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: We can find out after you have sat down.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bren sets two matching stone tiles on a tray. Anwen covers them before he can begin explaining.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: I was only going to show—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: I know. So were they.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We need the order of the memories. The fragment shows too many things at once.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Chandelure keeps impressions. Durant keeps their sequence. Neither will make the choice to look for you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What if I already looked, and forgetting was the only way I could bear it?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Anwen reaches toward the cloth, sees Celebi watching, and leaves her hand beside it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Then I would like to hear you say when to stop.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: How will we know it is really you in there?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You keep talking from this side. Ordinary things. Things the memory could not know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What if I ask you to keep going and you think I should stop?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then we shall probably argue. You will still hear me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi pushes the cloth an inch away. No one moves it back.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We came all this way.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Resting does not abandon the reason you came. Prepare first.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You agree on a signal: either companion can pause an overwhelming memory. Recovering the past remains Celebi’s choice.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I have a signal. Why am I still afraid nobody will stop?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Who would you like to practice it with?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Me. We can start by stopping this conversation.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Wait. Yes. That is the word. I meant it that time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: Recognizing a voice does not tell you what its speaker was doing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Dialga’s recorded voice
lines.text: Again.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought it was an order.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: You have one word. Give it room to mean more.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: An echo is a cup which has kept the shape of a voice—
lines.direction: lyrical at first; then deliberately plain

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Elian. Celebi is frightened.
lines.direction: lyrical at first; then deliberately plain

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: Yes. I am sorry. I was making myself sound certain.
lines.direction: lyrical at first; then deliberately plain

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What do you actually know?
lines.direction: lyrical at first; then deliberately plain

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: That we can stop. That you will not be left alone in the memory. Everything else, we check together.
lines.direction: lyrical at first; then deliberately plain

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: I thought if I sounded certain, you would feel safer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I felt as though you knew something terrible and were waiting for me to catch up.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I did too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Elian
lines.text: Then I owe both of you a much less impressive explanation.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A controlled battle prepares you for the watcher’s pressure before the next impression.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi examines a widening crack before Dialga arrives.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I knew it was failing. I did not wait.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I saw the crack. I remember thinking there was no time to find anyone.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was there?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know. I cannot remember looking.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Leave that question open. You are allowed to see the rest before answering it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Winning earns help. It does not oblige you to look.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I want to. Stay with me.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Chandelure holds its flame above the fragment. The clearing falls away. You see the anchor before the loop: cracked, failing, already releasing a surge.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I remember the sound. I thought I had time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In the impression, Celebi reaches into the failure alone. Green light holds for a moment, then collapses. The small body beside the anchor does not move.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Wait.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The present Celebi is rigid against your shoulder. Anwen raises her hand toward the lantern but waits for its answer.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Keep going.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dialga arrives. He calls once, then again. Nothing answers. The world folds backward.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Oh.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The lantern lowers. Your own hands are still braced for a fall that happened somewhere else.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Celebi?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am here. I know. I can hear you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: The lantern is beside you. Feel the warmth before you move.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He was calling me. I thought he was angry with me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You shift closer. Your sleeve catches on a twig and jerks your elbow back.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You are caught.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I appear to be losing a fight with a very small tree.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi frees the cloth. Its hand stays on the torn seam.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not want to tell you I am all right. You will know I am lying.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then do not. I can sit here either way.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Durant’s traces can establish how many times the event occurred. Its trial tests resource discipline.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The colony lays the impressions in sequence. Celebi falls. Dialga turns time back. The anchor is damaged again. Celebi reaches toward it again.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It was never repaired.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sequence repeats beyond counting. Each reversal adds incompatible moments. Dialga loses the order of them, then the ability to distinguish the present from the loss. The Primal shape emerges inside the loop.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Stop there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Durant closes the path between the records. The sound under the roots becomes ordinary footsteps.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He brought me back. Then he kept trying to bring me back. Does he know I got up?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: We do not have that part.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will look for it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I want to go straight to him. I know you are about to tell me why we cannot.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I want to go too. We still do not know how to reach him.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi looks down at the closed record, furious with it and unable to leave it behind.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.text: These matching tiles have different temporal wear. We first thought they were copies.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They all feel like the original.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: The archive contains several versions of a single event.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Look at the wear on this edge. Remarkable. It means the same stone has—

lines.text: Bren notices Celebi has backed away from the tray.
lines.direction: absorbed enthusiasm settling into consideration

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: I have done it again. Treated the evidence as though nobody had to live through it.
lines.direction: absorbed enthusiasm settling into consideration

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You can be interested. I just need a little warning.
lines.direction: absorbed enthusiasm settling into consideration

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: Before the next tray, then. Would you rather see it, hear about it, or leave it until later?

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Hear about it first. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: I rehearsed that explanation for years. I did not rehearse having the person in the record here to hear it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You looked so happy to have worked it out. I was angry with you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Bren
lines.text: You had every reason. I am glad you told me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Show us the next tray slowly. We will ask when we need the explanation.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You prepare for changing conditions while the colony compares its records.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sequence shows a damaged anchor, Celebi’s energy, then reversal. The next sequence begins with the anchor damaged again.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It brought back the moment before. It did not repair it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: The crack comes back every time. He keeps arriving at the same answer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: He may no longer know which arrival he is in.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: The final memory opens. Celebi deliberately enters Dialga’s loop and reaches him for a moment. The damaged anchor buckles. Still connected to it, Celebi jumps to escape.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The surge tears its memories along the route. It reaches Ilex Forest alive. Dialga never sees the escape; he remains inside the attempt, waiting for an answer.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I was trying to tell him I was there. I could not make him turn his head.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You got out.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I left him calling.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: You were coming apart. You got out.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi presses both hands against the trace. For a moment you think it is going to open it again.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I wanted the old me to know what to do.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It was you. Frightened, trying to reach someone. I know that one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You make it sound as though that is enough.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It is enough for me to want to go with you. We shall need a plan as well.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: I can copy the trace. You do not have to keep holding it to make it remain.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Slowly, Celebi uncurls its hands.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The recovered trace is copied under Toma’s supervision. Galactic’s latest offer names a 2020 staging realm and a route toward the origin site.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought I would recognize myself when it came back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I recognize being certain I could reach him. It is embarrassing. I wanted that person to have a better plan.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: You also stayed for the last boats. Maren remembers that person.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am trying to fit them together.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Toma threads the copied pages. One knot refuses to tighten; he swears at it under his breath.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: There. You have something in common.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am considerably more polite to knots.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Then I shall remember you as a judgmental client.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Neri must return to warn Newbank. She presses Maren’s empty food tin into your hand.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Bring it back. She counts them.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Rowan keeps sending sweet berries. I do not like them very much.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: An alarming revelation. Shall we tell him?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Not yet. I want to tell him myself, when we call.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The departure board changes. Every destination becomes DELAYED. Above the city, Eternatus closes a black canopy over the sky.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot feel the sunrise anywhere.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Stop looking up. You are standing on the medicine delivery.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She lifts a crate from beneath your feet and shoulders past you into a crowded shelter.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We are looking for the origin route.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: So is everyone who comes through that door. Can you carry this end?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You help her move the crate. Celebi lights the stairwell. A child reaches toward the green glow, then falls asleep against a bundle of coats.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Good. You can do something besides make promises.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We have been repairing the passages.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Then you have seen what their repairs look like here.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Galactic’s array forces changing worlds toward Dialga’s repeating reference. Eternatus supplies power. ADP enforces the imposed order; its Dialga is a manifestation of the loop.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We cannot fix the whole city tonight.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I asked for a crate. The rest was your idea.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pours three drinks and has to lean against the counter while the kettle fills.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Have you slept?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Have you?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For once, Celebi has nothing ready to say.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The shelter needs its medicine.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Marshal
lines.text: Exceptions compromise the system.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Those people are part of the system.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You reopen access and deliver supplies. The shelter remembers being promised a tomorrow that never arrives.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Top shelf. The medicine is for a man who insists he is not ill because he can still complain.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You know everyone here?
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I know who takes sugar, who cannot use the stairs, and who says they will eat later.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Which one are you?
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vale looks at the untouched plate behind the counter.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You two are becoming inconvenient.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact; she knows every person

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You have been staring at my plate.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I was hoping you would eat if I did.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Manipulative. Pass the bread.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am writing that down. Rowan might need the technique.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The furnace district shines while homes remain dark.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The city is not powering the tower. Something above it is.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I keep listening for a bird.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: There was one at the shelter yesterday. It stole somebody’s biscuit. Great improvement in morale.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did anyone hear it sing?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: We were too busy accusing one another of feeding it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Engineer
lines.text: Stopping wastes everything committed. We are close.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Show a reading that says that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: There is none. Each failed synchronization drives Galactic to demand more output from Eternatus.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: They broadcast three completion dates. I had a little celebration planned for the first.
lines.direction: honesty stripped of official reassurance

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What happened to it?
lines.direction: honesty stripped of official reassurance

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: We ate the cake in the dark. It was someone’s birthday by then.
lines.direction: honesty stripped of official reassurance

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Do you still believe the light will come back?
lines.direction: honesty stripped of official reassurance

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I believe the people in that shelter need tonight to happen. Ask me about the sky afterward.
lines.direction: honesty stripped of official reassurance

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You bought cake for the first completion date.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Yes. That is the part of the story you are allowed to find foolish.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What kind?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Lemon. I would like another reason to buy one. I am very tired of hating the announcements.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Give me the tower and I can get people moving.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We will clear the way.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Eternatus withdraws. Evacuation begins through a narrow opening. This victory stands, but the array still receives commands from its central connection.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Something on the other side is keeping it running.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A narrow opening appears in the canopy. Someone in the shelter begins to count the stars and loses their place.
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Look at it for a moment. The tower can spare us that.
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I had forgotten how far away a sky could be.
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you get everyone through the opening?
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The first group. There are more. But the first group is through.
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She says it again, more quietly, where only the two of you can hear.
lines.direction: brief relief; do not rush into another emergency

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The first group is through. I keep saying it because I expected someone to tell me I had missed a name.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You checked the register.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Twice. I would like to stop checking it for a minute.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Look at the sky. I will hold the page open.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At the central connection, Saturn stands beneath the threefold guardian. The array’s control lights show every damaged route you have crossed.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: We can complete what Dialga began. The local failures will end when the reference is stable.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He is trying to save me. I am alive. He does not know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: A reconstruction within the anomaly may produce convincing testimony.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is Celebi. You have been following us across half the roads you closed.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: I know what the readings say.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then turn them off and look at me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Saturn looks. For a moment, the room is quiet enough to hear Vale’s exhausted breathing over your receiver.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: There are people waiting on your last completion date, Commander.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: There will be no more dates after this one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian falls. Correction commands cease. The origin approach appears, but channels around it slip out of alignment.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can reach that one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It catches the nearest passage. Another strains. Celebi turns toward it before you can answer.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Celebi. Vale has the other end.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I need a count before you take the load. Answer me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Green light floods the receiver. Celebi’s hand becomes faint enough to see the far wall through it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Let go.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot. There are people—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I know. I know. Let go of this end. Look at me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You catch its wrist. For one terrible moment you cannot feel whether you are holding anything.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: Emergency release. Left console. Take it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He puts the control in Vale’s hands. The corridor shudders and steadies. Celebi falls against you, suddenly solid and very small.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You hurt my hand.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You let go so quickly that it has to catch your sleeve.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought you were gone.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I could have held it longer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You did not hear me. I was trying to tell you we had it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I heard. I was afraid to believe you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Saturn is still looking at the controls he surrendered. Nobody thanks him. There is too much happening for that.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I need a minute before I can talk about this.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi stays on your sleeve. It gives you the minute.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The shelter needs its medicine.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Marshal
lines.text: Exceptions compromise the system.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Packed luggage waits beneath an empty departure board.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Those places still exist. The system rejected them because they kept changing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The woman with that blue case has been packed since the first announcement.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Does she still check the board?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Every meal. I stopped telling her she need not bother.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will leave the route marker where she can see it from the case.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We helped these places.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: You stabilized deviations.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Newbank, Edda’s refuge, and recovering Magma settlements are scheduled for correction.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: There is a place for your shelter on the correction list.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Of course there is. We kept admitting people after they ordered the register closed.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They marked helping people as an error.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: They can argue about the spelling. I need someone to carry blankets to the lower room.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can do that.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Thank you. That was not a small thing to ask.
lines.direction: anger kept useful

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They put helping people on the correction list.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: They put my name on it. The people would prefer to be left out of the argument.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What can we do?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Blankets downstairs. Then come back. I would rather you asked that question twice than tried to guess everything at once.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is Celebi. You have been following us across half the roads you closed.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: I know what the readings say.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then turn them off and look at me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Saturn looks. For a moment, the room is quiet enough to hear Vale’s exhausted breathing over your receiver.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: There are people waiting on your last completion date, Commander.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: There will be no more dates after this one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian falls. Correction commands cease. The origin approach appears, but channels around it slip out of alignment.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can reach that one.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It catches the nearest passage. Another strains. Celebi turns toward it before you can answer.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Celebi. Vale has the other end.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I need a count before you take the load. Answer me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Green light floods the receiver. Celebi’s hand becomes faint enough to see the far wall through it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Let go.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot. There are people—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I know. I know. Let go of this end. Look at me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You catch its wrist. For one terrible moment you cannot feel whether you are holding anything.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Saturn
lines.text: Emergency release. Left console. Take it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He puts the control in Vale’s hands. The corridor shudders and steadies. Celebi falls against you, suddenly solid and very small.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You hurt my hand.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You let go so quickly that it has to catch your sleeve.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought you were gone.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I could have held it longer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You did not hear me. I was trying to tell you we had it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I heard. I was afraid to believe you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Saturn is still looking at the controls he surrendered. Nobody thanks him. There is too much happening for that.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I need a minute before I can talk about this.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi stays on your sleeve. It gives you the minute.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The array’s commands have stopped, but the freed channels strain against one another. Earlier records identify paired energy systems in 2019.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You need more hands on more than one side. I can keep this corridor open. I cannot keep you alive by guessing when you intend to collapse.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I said I was sorry.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Yes. I heard you. I need a plan for the next time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi turns toward you. You are looking at the receiver in Vale’s hand.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: When you started disappearing, I could not remember whether I was supposed to hold on or let go.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You were holding too tightly.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I know.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vale takes the empty cups away. The noise gives you both something to look at.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I heard you shouting. I kept thinking if I answered, I would stop holding it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I was angry. I still am. I also want to go with you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Both?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Both.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You establish a return beacon. Vale writes your names on the watch roster, leaving space between them for a third.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Send me sunlight when you find some. A picture, a reading, anything ordinary.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We will include the time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Thank you. I have missed having a reason to care which hour it is.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The stream runs one way. Sunlight moves through the trees. Celebi turns back to check that the corridor is still there.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: It is holding. You can look somewhere else for a minute.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Across the relay, Pikachu gives a signal. Zekrom waits for a second signal before the wires begin to hum.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It waited.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: You can see the whole board from here. Come and—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could we sit first?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Jun looks from your wrist to the receiver marks pressed into Celebi’s hands. He pulls two stools out from under the bench.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Yes. Sorry. I have been rehearsing the explanation instead of looking at the people who needed it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We had a bad argument.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We have not finished having it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: I shall put the kettle on very slowly.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: While Jun finds the cups, you lay your hands flat on the bench so Celebi can see them.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I should not have grabbed you like that.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought you wanted me to choose you instead of everyone else.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I wanted you to come back far enough to hear us. I did a poor job of explaining it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Next time, give me something smaller than everyone to carry.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: That, I can help with.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: His system keeps the channels independent. The partners offer help at once; the battles are rehearsals before the real repair.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: When the first connection fails, who takes over?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can—
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Someone else.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We have not decided.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You assign navigation, protection, engineering, and local passage care separately. Helping means taking work Celebi can stop doing.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You send Vale a picture of a patch of sunlight beside the relay. Celebi insists on including the cup sitting in it.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Received. Very ordinary. Thank you.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We checked. It has been on the same side of the cup all morning.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Excellent engineering.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: I am putting that in the report.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Under what?
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Evidence that we are allowed to like things.
lines.direction: small pleasures; let the mood lift

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: You can erase your name from one of those boxes, Celebi. It will not make the paper fall apart.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: I wanted to see who would write theirs first.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Good. We have found a problem while it is still made of pencil.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: The rehearsal tests handing Energy and responsibility onward.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A sample relay fails deliberately. Its backup takes over.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I felt it slipping. I waited. It held.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I waited when the relay failed. I wanted to move so badly.
lines.direction: light touch; no shame attached to a correction

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: I saw. That is why we rehearse while there is still someone to catch a mistake.
lines.direction: light touch; no shame attached to a correction

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What happens if you make one?
lines.direction: light touch; no shame attached to a correction

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: The same thing. You tell me. Preferably before I announce that everything is under control.
lines.direction: light touch; no shame attached to a correction

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That sounds like a useful announcement to postpone.
lines.direction: light touch; no shame attached to a correction

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I did nothing when it slipped. My whole body wanted to move.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I saw. I nearly told you to wait, which would have been extremely annoying.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: I have been on both sides of that conversation. We can rehearse the silence too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Please. I would like to know you can see me trying.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Teams work in separate rooms using agreed signals. Reshiram & Charizard provide the finishing pulse.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Trust means agreeing, then giving others a chance to do their part.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You establish confirmation signals and an abort call.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I could not see Celebi from the other room. I kept wanting to go and check.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Did you hear the signal?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes. Then I wanted to go and check that the signal was right.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Next time, tell me afterward. I thought you were the one who found waiting easy.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Venn brings recovered instruments. He agrees to a controlled stress test before they join the relay.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: I thought understanding the whole system excused what happened in one place.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What are you doing about that place?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: Opening the routes I helped close.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rowan secures the forest shrine. Mira and Tess distribute records. Ada supplies independent power. Edda and Maren coordinate safe arrivals. Dr. Sen, Neri, Rhea, Sera, Anwen, and Vale each take responsibility for their local passages.

lines.text: Edda would not sign the clearance report.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: She said clearing a passage did not clear my record. Then she gave me a list of the next three passages.
lines.direction: accountable, not a redemption speech

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Did you take it?
lines.direction: accountable, not a redemption speech

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: It is in my pocket. I am not asking you to trust me because I brought a list.
lines.direction: accountable, not a redemption speech

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Good. Tell us which route you opened.
lines.direction: accountable, not a redemption speech

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: The eastern crossing. Oren has checked it. Twice.
lines.direction: accountable, not a redemption speech

lines.text: Oren checked the crossing twice. I asked whether that meant he trusted my reading.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What did he say?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: That it meant he was taking people across it. I had made the question about me again.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then tell Mira which route is open. She can decide what else she wants to ask.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Mewtwo
lines.text: What if Dialga cannot recognize you?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We withdraw if the relays cannot hold. We change the plan. We do not force everyone to repeat it until I get my answer.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The battle completes the rehearsal. Then the teams perform a real limited repair: shared power, controlled release, adapted signals, and Celebi’s mending. A family crosses safely.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Connection stable. The others are holding. We have them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: You have built a way to retreat. Do you believe using it would mean failure?
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.text: I am trying not to.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: If Celebi calls the signal, I will go back. Even if I think we could stay longer.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Mewtwo
lines.text: And you?
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I will tell the truth about when I need it. I will not make my friend guess.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.text: Mew drifts between the marked stations, following the same route in its own untidy way.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.text: I thought having a way back would make it easier to go.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: Has it?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: A little. I am still afraid I will be too ashamed to use it.

lines.text: Then we keep practicing the return until it feels like part of arriving.

lines.text: You establish a measured release threshold.

lines.text: It felt like we were doing nothing.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: I know. I am terrible at waiting when I cannot see what the other person is fixing.

lines.text: What do you do?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I stopped when you called. I wanted you to say it was enough.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: It was enough for that conduit. I cannot make the rest of the journey that tidy.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then I will take this one. We have had very few problems small enough to finish.

lines.text: Jun writes the successful reading down, leaving both your names beside it.

lines.text: Pikachu & Zekrom take over the power supply. Celebi monitors only one passage.

lines.text: What if another needs me?
