lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: Oren checked the crossing twice. I asked whether that meant he trusted my reading.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What did he say?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Venn
lines.text: That it meant he was taking people across it. I had made the question about me again.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then tell Mira which route is open. She can decide what else she wants to ask.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Mewtwo
lines.text: What if Dialga cannot recognize you?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We withdraw if the relays cannot hold. We change the plan. We do not force everyone to repeat it until I get my answer.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The battle completes the rehearsal. Then the teams perform a real limited repair: shared power, controlled release, adapted signals, and Celebi’s mending. A family crosses safely.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Connection stable. The others are holding. We have them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Mewtwo
lines.text: You have built a way to retreat. Do you believe using it would mean failure?
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am trying not to.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: If Celebi calls the signal, I will go back. Even if I think we could stay longer.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Mewtwo
lines.text: And you?
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I will tell the truth about when I need it. I will not make my friend guess.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Mew drifts between the marked stations, following the same route in its own untidy way.
lines.direction: measured curiosity; allow the party to answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought having a way back would make it easier to go.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Has it?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: A little. I am still afraid I will be too ashamed to use it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: Then we keep practicing the return until it feels like part of arriving.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A real shared repair has held. In 2020, evacuations continue under controlled channels. Eternatus remains contained. The origin approach now points to 2024 Indianapolis.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I have Toma’s copies. He has written three separate objections to my bindings.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Two objections. The third is a suggested improvement.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Mira, send him the bread file.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Can the book people use a different channel? I need Rhea’s valve reading.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: You have it. Dalen says the gloves are still borrowed.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Is this what you all sound like when nobody is being evacuated?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You reach for the volume control.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Leave it. I did not ask you to turn it down.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Rowan? Are you there?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Yes. Bram is repairing a gate. It has ceased to be a peaceful evening.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I like the sour berries. I should have told you sooner.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: There is a pause long enough for you to hear the forest through his receiver.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I can manage sour berries.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I know. That is why I wish I had told you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Jun
lines.text: The teams are ready. The rest can wait until morning.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: One more check.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: No. Come and sit. I want to be the one who asks this time.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You leave the channel open. Nobody has anything important left to report.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vale’s corridor opens onto broken forest and exposed anchor foundations. Dialga appears, vanishes, and appears a little too late in the same place.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He is waiting for the moment before I fall.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can he see us?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know. I have been pretending the answer would be easier once we got here.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Independent power ready.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dr. Sen
lines.text: Newbank is carrying its own channel. Leave our changes where they are.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Retreat corridor open. I will say when that changes. You will answer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I will answer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The anchor will reconnect the eras in sequence, preserving the communities that grew around the fractures. Nobody is offering to make their histories disappear.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What if he asks you to stay?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I want to say I would know what to do.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can keep asking each other. Even in there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rowan clears his throat over the channel. From far away comes the sound of a cup being put down.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I moved them off the shelf. The shrine has been shaking.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You kept the cracked one?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: It took me years to learn how to hold it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi touches your sleeve. This time it waits for you to take its hand.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Come on, then. Before I try to think of a braver way to say it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: Every world you passed is still damaged.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: People are rebuilding them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They get a future. You keep asking them to wait.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Venn escorts the defeated holdouts away. Saturn orders personnel to relinquish stations and assist local keepers. Their help does not erase their responsibility.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Venn is waiting for somebody to tell him he did the right thing.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He did.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Today. I am trying to find a way to say today without sounding cruel.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Let him do the next thing. There will be time for words when the stations are clear.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Stay back. I can still hold it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I remember believing that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do you believe now?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You are coming with me.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Memories repeat fixed details. The present contains people making new choices. Anwen confirms your grounding signals.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: You asked Celebi to name the present. What would you name?
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Your lantern. Vale breathing into the receiver. My hands shaking.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Mine are, too.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You could have said.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Yes. I am learning to take the chair I keep offering everyone else.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: My hands are shaking. I hoped you would not notice over the receiver.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I hoped the same thing about mine.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Everyone is doing that. I would like us to stop being quite so considerate.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Agreed. I am frightened, and I can still hold the lantern.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The fallen Celebi appears beside Dialga. The scene resets when approached.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Name something happening now.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You are speaking. And we were not here together before.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi marks a safe route through the impressions. The engineering teams complete the fragment installation. Both preparations are ready.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He was looking at the place where I used to be. I wanted to go and stand there so he would see me.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Would that have been you, or the memory?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know. Thank you for asking while I could still answer.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: The route is marked. Come back to the sound of us if you lose it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The fragment is seated. Independent relays hold the surrounding channels. Dialga sees Celebi approach and recoils as though the fall has begun again.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: No. Stay back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am beside someone this time. Look.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For a moment his gaze follows your hand. Then he looks past you, toward the place where the memory says Celebi must be.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: There is time. I can still—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We need an opening. He cannot hear the end of anything while it keeps beginning.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I will be ready.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is what you said at the array.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi flinches. You wish you had found another way to say it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then ask me who is holding the other channels.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Who is holding them?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Ada. Dr. Sen. Rhea. Vale. People who will be very annoyed if I take their work away.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Correct.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You manage a breath. Celebi touches the healed scratch on your hand, then turns toward Dialga.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Victory opens the center of the loop. Celebi approaches with you while the relays carry the channels. The anchor replays the original fall.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: I was too late.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Yes.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The answer makes him look at it. Celebi does not move into the place the memory has left empty.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: I brought you back. You fell again.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I remember. Then I came looking for you. The surge threw me out. I forgot you, and I was found.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: You lived?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I complained about somebody’s tea. I frightened my friend. I have been trying to tell you all of it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Another channel strains. Celebi turns toward it, catches itself, and calls into the receiver.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Vale. The eastern connection.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: We have it. Stay where you are.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi waits. The connection steadies without it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: And if the next moment takes you?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi looks at you. There is no answer you can promise for it.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I am afraid of that too.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: Then how can I let it come?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Stay with us for this one. You do not have to reach any further yet.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi mends the anchor. Dialga keeps his gaze on the two of you. For the first time, the metallic cry reaches its end.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The loop releases. His Primal shape recedes. Around you, separate channels find their own sequence.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: I can still remember it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can hear you.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dialga lowers his head. Celebi rests a hand against it, and you wait until he lifts it again.
lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: Will you come back?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: To visit. You will have to let the visit end.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dialga
lines.text: I do not know whether I can.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then tell me when it frightens you. We will begin there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: Every world you passed is still damaged.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: People are rebuilding them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They get a future. You keep asking them to wait.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Venn escorts the defeated holdouts away. Saturn orders personnel to relinquish stations and assist local keepers. Their help does not erase their responsibility.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Venn is waiting for somebody to tell him he did the right thing.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: He did.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Today. I am trying to find a way to say today without sounding cruel.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Let him do the next thing. There will be time for words when the stations are clear.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Dr. Sen
lines.text: Newbank is stable. Stop routing its load through Celebi.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can let that one go?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: They have it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The junction supports several distinct signals. It no longer forces them into one point.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Dr. Sen has the channel. I can stop watching that dial.
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Are you going to?
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vale moves her hand away from the receiver and rests it against the wall.
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Apparently I am.
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Does it feel strange?
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Very. Keep talking. I shall get used to it.
lines.direction: plain relief, with a little disbelief

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I have taken my hand off the dial. You may both stop watching me do it.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I was waiting to see if you would put it back.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: So was I. Dr. Sen is going to hear an extremely unnecessary thank-you shortly.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: She can put it under findings. Neri can put it under bread.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The fragment projects Magma’s basin. Rhea recognizes its readings from her own station.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Easy. We know this part.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You are far away.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Still listening.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi seats the fragment without carrying its strain alone. Anwen helps establish the grounding route. Both preparations are ready.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That is the reading. Stop there.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You sound so sure.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I have checked it with three people who are prepared to disagree with me. It is a considerable improvement in technique.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Keep the channel open. I would like some of that improvement nearby.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: There is time. I can still—
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: I will be ready.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: That is what you said at the array.
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.direction: Observe physical details; allow silence.

lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.

lines.text: Who is holding them?
lines.direction: Speak to the person present; let hesitation, anger or affection remain in the line.
